text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Nuclear plants emit no greenhouse gases during operation.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Nuclear life-cycle emissions are similar to wind and about a third of solar per unit of electricity.","cited_pids":["8ef6c9360938#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The IAEA links higher nuclear output, alongside renewables and coal-to-gas switching, to a levelling of global CO2 emissions.","cited_pids":["7e88e103d8fb#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A 16-country study found that a 1% CO2 cut required a 2.907% increase in nuclear generation versus 4.902% for renewables.","cited_pids":["0819b42abe08#0","946b45d61e84#2"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"The 16-country study concluded nuclear is more cost-efficient than renewables for cutting CO2, even counting accident risks.","cited_pids":["0819b42abe08#0","946b45d61e84#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A Swedish model found little cost benefit from reinvesting in nuclear once existing plants retire.","cited_pids":["6b0ccdbcf9aa#1"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Nuclear construction projects have reported an average cost overrun of 102.5%.","cited_pids":["06384d0fb532#2"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Critics cite health, accident and nuclear waste risks of nuclear power.","cited_pids":["4e9b20313655#3"]}]}
